title: Session-lease windows and stream coalescer: ergonomics + cross-SDK parity
author: Maya Singh
description: Context: Teams reported two friction points when upgrading long-lived streams across SDKs: (1) token/session lease churn causing unnecessary reauth amplification under bursty traffic and (2) noisy small-chunk stream emissions that make consumer code and telemetry noisy. This PR implements a conservative session-lease windowing API and a stream coalescer in the TypeScript SDK to smooth emissions and reduce reauth/restoral churn, plus parity tests to align behavior with Python and Go SDKs. Motivation: improve cross-SDK ergonomics for streaming consumers, reduce token rotation storms, and expose a compact config surface for instrumenting lease behavior without breaking existing APIs. Changes in this PR: added a SessionLeaseManager abstraction with TTL windowing and jittered renew scheduling; implemented StreamCoalescer that buffers sub-chunks for up to 30ms or until a size threshold, exposing a pause/resume-friendly async generator wrapper; added backward-compatible factory hooks to the existing Client constructor to opt into lease-window behavior; added integration tests simulating credential failover and stream resume; added examples and docs snippets; bumped package minor to 1.29.0 and emitted changelog entries. Checklist: - [x] SessionLeaseManager core impl - [x] StreamCoalescer async generator wrapper - [x] Cross-SDK parity tests (integration harness) - [x] Documentation and examples - [x] Telemetry points (lease-renew, lease-expire, coalesce-batch) - [x] Benchmarks (local microbenchmarks show 18-24% reduction in reauths for bursty scenarios) Commits summary: feat(lease): add SessionLeaseManager with windowed renew; feat(stream): implement StreamCoalescer generator wrapper; test(integration): add cross-sdk session-lease parity tests; docs: usage examples and changelog; ci: add e2e matrix job. Changed areas (high-level): src/session/SessionLeaseManager.ts; src/stream/StreamCoalescer.ts; src/client/factory.ts; tests/integration/session-lease.parity.spec.ts; examples/streaming/lease-example.ts; docs/streaming.md; CHANGELOG.md; package.json (minor bump). Review conversation (high-level): - Tom: "Looks good overall; can we make the default coalesce window opt-in?" Author: "Default is off; constructor flag enableLeaseWindow: true opt-in required — clarified in docs." - Priya: "Telemetry naming nit and suggest metric for coalesce-latency." Author: "Added coalesce_latency histogram and emission_count metric." - Ethan: "Edge case: what if client is used very sporadically? Does lease renewal keep connections warm unnecessarily?" Author: "We added idle detection (no active streams) to pause renewals after 2x TTL with feature flag to opt into eager renewal." - QA: "Flaky test observed on CI at 30ms thresholds" Author: "Adjusted test timing and added retry guard; CI matrix now includes a slow node job." CI summary: initial run had lint warning in examples, fixed; tests ran in matrix for node 16/18 and passed; one flaky integration was stabilized by test tweak; final CI status: pass. Merge outcome: merged via squash with message summarizing key user-visible changes and upgrade guidance. Release notes: "Introduce optional SessionLeaseManager and StreamCoalescer to reduce token rotation noise and smooth streaming chunk emissions. Opt-in via client factory flag enableLeaseWindow; minor bump to 1.29.0. See docs/streaming.md for migration steps and telemetry details." Related: coordinated follow-ups in redwood-sdk-python and redwood-sdk-go to adopt the same opt-in defaults and the integration harness has a follow-up ticket ENG-2187.
